privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: RoamGem is run by {{name}}, {{address}} ("we"). We keep as little about you as we can, and never sell it. Questions: {{email}}.
privacy.collect1: Your trips: where you start and end, the days, your vehicle and settings, and the plan we make. Trips are saved so you can open and share them.
privacy.collect2: An account, if you make one: your email address and your password, stored only as a secure hash.
privacy.collect3: Whether you have Plus or a Trip pass. Payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your card.
privacy.collect4: Clicks on booking links (which partner, which trip), so we know which partners help travellers. Not what you book.
privacy.collect5: Community photos you post, with the place you took them. We check the photo was taken near the gem; the photo is public only after a check.
privacy.collect6: Technical data every website receives, such as your IP address, used to keep the service safe and to limit misuse.
privacy.collectUse: We use this to plan and save your trips, run your account and payments, show community photos, and keep RoamGem working and safe (contract and legitimate interest under the GDPR).
privacy.who1: Railway: hosts RoamGem and its database (servers may be outside the EU, under the EU standard contractual clauses).
privacy.who2: Anthropic (Claude): writes the trip plan from your route and settings. No account details are sent.
privacy.who3: Google Maps Platform: routes, places, photos and maps.
privacy.who4: Stripe: payments for Plus and the Trip pass.
privacy.who5: OpenFreeMap: the map tiles of the globe.
privacy.who6: Booking partners (such as Booking.com, Pitchup, Vrbo, GetYourGuide): only when you click through to them. What happens there falls under their privacy policy.
privacy.keep: Trips and your account stay until you delete them or ask us to. Click counts hold no personal details beyond your account, if you were signed in, and go when your account goes. Server logs are kept for a short time only, for safety.
privacy.rights: You may see, correct, download or delete your data, object to its use, and withdraw consent. Email {{email}} and we answer within a month. You may also complain to your data protection authority.
privacy.cookies: RoamGem uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser stores only what RoamGem needs to work: that you are signed in, your language, and the key that lets you change a trip you planned on this device. That is why there is no cookie banner. Booking partners may set their own cookies once you visit their sites.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These terms apply to RoamGem, run by {{name}}, {{address}}. By using RoamGem you agree to them.
terms.what: RoamGem plans road trips: the days, where to sleep, gems on the way and what it may cost. It is a planning aid. You stay responsible for your journey, your vehicle and following the road rules.
terms.estimates: Costs, tolls, vignettes, prices of stays and driving times are estimates from public prices and tables, and change over time. Gems are real places found on Google with their ratings, but opening hours, access and conditions change. Check them before you go, and always follow the road signs, local rules and limits for your vehicle (height, weight, low-emission zones).
terms.partners: Some links lead to partners such as Booking.com, Pitchup, Vrbo, Roadsurfer, Indie Campers and GetYourGuide. When you book through them we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you. Your booking is a contract between you and that partner.
terms.plus1: Plus is a subscription, paid monthly or yearly. It renews until you stop it; you can stop it any time and it keeps working until the end of the paid month or year.
terms.plus2: The Trip pass is a one-off payment: every Plus feature, for one trip.
terms.plus3: Both start right away when you pay. Because the service starts at once, the 14-day right of withdrawal ends when you ask us to start it. If something does not work, email us and we will put it right.
terms.community: You keep the rights to photos you post. You allow RoamGem to show them in the app and in its own promotion, with your explorer name. Post only your own photos, nothing unsafe, offensive or private about others. We may remove posts and suggested gems that break these rules.
terms.liability: We do our best to keep RoamGem correct and available, but cannot promise it is always error-free. We are not liable for indirect damage, or for what partners and places do. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer by law.
terms.changes: We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. The law of {{country}} applies, without taking away the protection of the law where you live. Questions: {{email}}.

pricing.a1: Yes. Stop from your account page; Plus keeps working until the end of the month or year you paid for.
pricing.q2: What happens to my trips if I stop?
pricing.a2: They stay. You can open every trip you saved; only new trips follow the free plan again.
pricing.q3: Do I need a card for the free plan?
pricing.a3: No. Plan and save one full trip without paying anything.
pricing.a4: One road trip a year: the Trip pass unlocks everything for that trip, once. Several trips, or planning and comparing a lot: Plus.
pricing.q5: How does the cheapest route work?
pricing.a5: RoamGem also asks Google for the route without toll roads and prices both. When it saves money, you see how much and how much longer it takes, and switch in one tap.

costWarning.CH: Switzerland: vehicles over 3.5 t pay a heavy-vehicle charge instead of the vignette.
